p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    points = [(i, j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j] > 1]
    color = grid[points[0][0]][points[0][1]]
    r0, c0 = min(i for i, j in points), min(j for i, j in points)
    shape = [(i-r0, j-c0) for i, j in points]
    sh, sw = max(i for i, j in shape)+1, max(j for i, j in shape)+1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for i in range(h-sh+1):
        for j in range(w-sw+1):
            if all(grid[i+a][j+b] == 0 for a,b in shape):
                for a,b in shape:
                    out[i+a][j+b] = color
    return out
''')
